description.value: Strange Fellows is an East Vancouver craft brewery known for blending old-world tradition with West Coast innovation, with a particular focus on sour, barrel-aged, and vintage limited releases alongside a broad roster of hoppy ales, stouts, pilsners, and Belgians. The tasting room on Clark Drive pours a rotating tap list that also includes cider, wine, and a non-alcoholic IPA, backed by a full snack-and-panini food menu sourced from a local bakery. Cyclists looking to stock up can fill growlers from most taps or shop packaged cans and bottles to carry on the road.

raw_osm.description: Inspired by tradition and creativity, Strange Fellows is an East Vancouver brewery that celebrates the strange* and extraordinary. The beer we make is influenced both by old world heritage and west coast innovation.
raw_osm.name: Strange Fellows Brewing

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery tasting room with a full food menu and growler-fill takeout on a cycling-accessible East Vancouver street; a clear and practical stop for touring cyclists.
